evidence ::= ⟨
  id: ID,
  type: EVIDENCE_TYPE,
  timestamp: TIME,

  test_result,        -- Automated test execution
  static_analysis,    -- Code analysis tool output
  type_check,         -- Type system verification
  manual_review,      -- Human review attestation
  audit_log,          -- Audit trail entry
  trace_verification, -- Traceability check

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-5jP_ZWlaA8SfDbhVxrG99", "§{{sectionNumber}}").5 (Staleness Detection)
content.text:
isStale : Binding → 𝔹

isStale(b) =
  b.verification = verified ∧
  (b.concrete.hash ≠ currentHash(b.concrete.uri) ∨
   ∃ e ∈ evidence(b). expired(e))

content.label: Constraint C-VERIFY-GROUNDING
content.description: Leaf elements must have verified or pending bindings for G4 to hold

content.label: Constraint C-VERIFY-FRESH
content.formula:
∀ b ∈ B. b.verification = verified →
  ¬isStale(b) ∨ staleness_age(b) < MAX_STALE_DURATION
content.description: Verified bindings must not be stale beyond threshold
